newsitem.title: ITALY: ABI sees Italian banks' performance deteriorating.
newsitem.headline: ABI sees Italian banks' performance deteriorating.

text.p: The economic performance of Italy's banking system is seen deteriorating considerably in the 1997-98 period, the Italian Banking Association (ABI) said.

ABI said in its latest Financial Outlook that banks were likely to suffer continuing pressure from "increased competition deriving from deregulation in the sector, growing institutionalisation of managed savings, as well as information technology innivations."
The report also forecast a slowdown in the rate of growth in overall bank deposits and loans.
But at the same time, the 1997-98 outlook saw a considerable slowing in the rate of growth of banks' bad loans.
ABI said a forecast contraction of margins, together with increased operating costs, "is seen resulting in a clear decline in in gross operating profits," -- Milan newsroom +392 66129589
